prompt: Create a playful full-body studio composite of a stylish teenage boy being followed by a tiny chibi version of himself. The main character is a realistic young man with voluminous dark brown wavy hair, clean face, relaxed slightly aloof expression, looking back over his shoulder while walking to the right. He wears a burgundy bomber jacket over a black hoodie, oversized faded blue cargo jeans with large side pockets, and gray-and-white sneakers; his right hand holds a clear plastic cup of iced tea or coffee. Behind him at lower left, include exactly 1 miniature chibi duplicate, about one third his height, with the same hair and outfit, exaggerated angry face, furrowed eyebrows, clenched teeth, and both hands gripping and pulling the loose fabric of the main character’s left pant leg backward, stretching the denim dramatically. Use a clean light gray seamless studio background with soft floor shadow, high-detail photorealistic rendering for the main teen, glossy 3D cartoon/anime styling for the chibi, and a humorous fashion-editorial mood. Add exactly 10 simple black hand-drawn doodle accents around the figures: 2 sparkle icons near the upper body, 1 sparkle icon to the right, 1 squiggly surprise mark near the main character’s head, 2 small steam-puff frustration clouds near the chibi, 1 anger symbol near the chibi’s head, and 3 short motion-line clusters around the stretched pant leg and feet. Keep the composition vertical, centered, with ample negative space, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
